description: NaLuO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four LuO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven LuO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-13°. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four LuO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven LuO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent Lu sites. In the first Lu site, Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five LuO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. There are four shorter (2.22 Å) and two longer (2.23 Å) Lu-O bond lengths. In the second Lu site, Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five LuO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-14°. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Lu atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Lu₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Lu atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Lu₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-12°.
